The structure of Ce4O10F6 (Ce2O5F3) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ce centers as octahedral, each coordinated by two F and four O neighbors, while O adopts tetrahedral environments with one Ce and three F neighbors. The Ce octahedra and O tetrahedra display corner-sharing, and corner-sharing is also observed between Ce octahedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
